physics-h2-q2.title: E tinyere ihe A
physics-h2-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h2-q2.material: E tinyere ihe A dị 3 kg na ihe B dị 2 kg ka ha na-emetụ onwe ha n'elu larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, a tinyekwara ike larịị 20 N ịkwọ n'akụkụ A. Kedu ọsọ nke ihe abụọ na ịdị ukwuu nke ike A na-akwọ B, n'usoro?
physics-h2-q2.s.s1.prompt: E tinyere ihe A dị 3 kg na ihe B dị 2 kg ka ha na-emetụ onwe ha n'elu larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, a tinyekwara ike larịị 20 N ịkwọ n'akụkụ A. Kedu ọsọ nke ihe abụọ na ịdị ukwuu nke ike A na-akwọ B, n'usoro?
physics-h2-q2.s.s1.explain: Ọsọ niile bụ $a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Naanị ike niile na-eme ka ihe B mee ọsọ bụ ike mmetụ nke A na-akwọ B, yabụ $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.

physics-h2-c.title: [Electromagnetic induction miri emi]
physics-h2-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h2-c.material: [Electromagnetic induction miri emi] Mgbe e wetara magnet nso coil, induced emf na-apụta (iwu Faraday na iwu Lenz). Ọkụ eletrik e kpatara na-asọ n'ụzọ nke 'na-egbochi' mgbanwe magnetic flux site na coil. Gịnị bụ ihe kpatara physics nke a, iji mezuo nchekwa gịnị?
physics-h2-c.s.s1.prompt: [Electromagnetic induction miri emi] Mgbe e wetara magnet nso coil, induced emf na-apụta (iwu Faraday na iwu Lenz). Ọkụ eletrik e kpatara na-asọ n'ụzọ nke 'na-egbochi' mgbanwe magnetic flux site na coil. Gịnị bụ ihe kpatara physics nke a, iji mezuo nchekwa gịnị?

physics-h2-c.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-h2-q5.title: N'ozi fiber-optic internet ọsọ
physics-h2-q5.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h2-q5.material: N'ozi fiber-optic internet ọsọ dị elu, ìhè na-agbasa n'ime isi fiber ruo ebe dị anya na-enweghị mfu n'ihi 'nlaghachi ndị zuru ezu n'ime (total internal reflection)'. Kedu ọnọdụ ziri ezi maka nlaghachi ndị zuru ezu n'ime ime?
physics-h2-q5.s.s1.prompt: N'ozi fiber-optic internet ọsọ dị elu, ìhè na-agbasa n'ime isi fiber ruo ebe dị anya na-enweghị mfu n'ihi 'nlaghachi ndị zuru ezu n'ime (total internal reflection)'. Kedu ọnọdụ ziri ezi maka nlaghachi ndị zuru ezu n'ime ime?

physics-killer-11.title: Akụkụ P na-abata kwụ
physics-killer-11.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-11.material: Akụkụ P na-abata kwụ ọtọ n'ime ikpo magnet edoro anya $B$ ma na-eme mmegharị gburugburu edoro anya, radius nke ụzọ ya bụ $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ ma period bụ $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Akụkụ Q na-abata kwụ ọtọ n'otu ikpo magnet dị ka P, ibu ya bụ okpukpu $4$ nke P, ịdị ukwuu ụgwọ ya bụ okpukpu $2$ nke P, ọsọ ya bụkwa okpukpu $3$ nke P. Leghara ike ndọda anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, radius na period nke ụzọ Q?
physics-killer-11.s.s1.prompt: Akụkụ P na-abata kwụ ọtọ n'ime ikpo magnet edoro anya $B$ ma na-eme mmegharị gburugburu edoro anya, radius nke ụzọ ya bụ $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ ma period bụ $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Akụkụ Q na-abata kwụ ọtọ n'otu ikpo magnet dị ka P, ibu ya bụ okpukpu $4$ nke P, ịdị ukwuu ụgwọ ya bụ okpukpu $2$ nke P, ọsọ ya bụkwa okpukpu $3$ nke P. Leghara ike ndọda anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, radius na period nke ụzọ Q?
physics-killer-11.s.s1.explain: $r\propto\dfrac{mv}{q}$ yabụ $\dfrac{r_Q}{r_P}=\dfrac{4m\cdot3v}{2q}\cdot\dfrac{q}{mv}=6\Rightarrow r_Q=5\times6=30\,\mathrm{cm}$. $T=\dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$ adabereghị n'ọsọ, yabụ $\dfrac{T_Q}{T_P}=\dfrac{4}{2}=2\Rightarrow T_Q=4\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Ọ bụrụ na e hapụ ntụnyere ụgwọ, $r=60\,\mathrm{cm}$, $T=8\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ①); ọ bụrụ na e were period dị ka ọ na-adabere n'ọsọ, $12\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ③); ọ bụrụ na e leghaara ntụnyere ibu na ụgwọ anya jiri ntụnyere ọsọ naanị, $r=15\,\mathrm{cm}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ④).
